verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.langchain.com (HTTP 200) with a documentation index, and individual doc pages are available in agent-friendly .md format (e.g., overview.md) that explicitly reference the llms.txt index for further crawling — this is exactly the agent-oriented docs pattern the story asks for. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully in practice.
